text.zh:
2B233 具有以下所有特性的波纹管密封涡旋压缩机和波纹管密封涡旋真空泵：
a．入口体积流量能够达到50 m³/h 或更大；
b．压缩比能够达到2：1 或更大；
c．所有与工艺气体接触的表面均由以下任何材料制造：
1．铝或铝合金；
2．氧化铝；
3．不锈钢；
4．镍或镍合金；
5．磷青铜；
6．含氟聚合物；
技术说明：
1．在涡旋压缩机或涡旋真空泵中，一对或多对相互啮合的涡旋盘或涡盘中形成月牙形气室，相互啮合的涡旋盘一个运动而另外一个保持不动。运动的涡盘围绕不动的涡盘旋转摆动，而自身不旋转。随着动涡轮盘绕静涡轮盘的运动，转向机器出口端月牙形气室逐步缩小（即气体被压缩）。
2．在波纹管密封涡旋压缩机或真空泵中，工艺气体通过一个金属波纹管与泵的润滑部件和外部大气完全隔开。波纹管的一端连接到动涡盘，另一端连接到真空泵的壳体。
3．含氟聚合物包括但不限于以下材料：
a．聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）；
b．聚全氟乙丙烯（FEP）；
text.en: 2B233 Bellows-sealed scroll compressors and bellows-sealed scroll vacuum pumps having all of the following characteristics: a. Capable of an inlet volumetric flow rate of 50 m³/h or greater; b. Capable of a compression ratio of 2:1 or greater; c. All surfaces in contact with the process gas are made of any of the following materials: 1. Aluminum or aluminum alloys; 2. Aluminum oxide; 3. Stainless steel; 4. Nickel or nickel alloys; 5. Phosphor bronze; 6. Fluoropolymers; Technical Notes: 1. In a scroll compressor or scroll vacuum pump, one or more pairs of intermeshing scrolls form crescent-shaped gas pockets, with one scroll moving and the other stationary. The moving scroll orbits the stationary scroll without rotating about its own axis. As the moving scroll orbits the stationary scroll, the crescent-shaped gas pockets progressively shrink toward the machine outlet, compressing the gas. 2. In a bellows-sealed scroll compressor or vacuum pump, a metal bellows completely isolates the process gas from the pump's lubricated parts and the outside atmosphere. One end of the bellows is attached to the moving scroll, and the other to the vacuum-pump housing. 3. Fluoropolymers include, but are not limited to, the following materials: a. Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE); b. Fluorinated ethylene propylene (FEP);

text.zh:
c．过氟烷氧基聚合物（PFA）；
d．聚三氟氯乙烯（PCTFE）；
e．偏氟乙烯-六氟丙烯共聚物。
text.en: c. Perfluoroalkoxy polymers (PFA); d. Polychlorotrifluoroethylene (PCTFE); e. Vinylidene fluoride–hexafluoropropylene copolymers.

title.zh: 专用毒气监测器和监测系统：
title.en: Dedicated toxic-gas monitors and monitoring systems:

summary.zh: 专用毒气监测器和监测系统：
summary.en: Dedicated toxic-gas monitors and monitoring systems:

text.zh:
2B351 专用毒气监测器和监测系统：
a．为连续操作而设计，可用于国家实施出口管制的化学品或有机化合物（含有浓度低于0.3 mg/m³ 的磷、硫、氟或氯）的检测；
b．设计用于检测受抑制的胆碱酯酶的活性。
text.en: 2B351 Dedicated toxic-gas monitors and monitoring systems: a. Designed for continuous operation and usable to detect chemicals subject to national export controls or organic compounds containing phosphorus, sulfur, fluorine, or chlorine at concentrations below 0.3 mg/m³; b. Designed to detect inhibited cholinesterase activity.

title.zh: 生物材料处理设备：
title.en: Biological material processing equipment:

summary.zh: 生物材料处理设备：
summary.en: Biological material processing equipment:

text.zh:
2B352 生物材料处理设备：
a．符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（2004 年第三版，日内瓦）所规定的生物安全水平三级（BL-3）、四级（BL-4）标准的全密闭设施；
说明：
1．“生物安全水平三级（BL-3）”是指生物医学或微生物学实验室，使用高效空气粒子过滤器（HEPA），在对外环境保持负压、人员和物品出入实行控制、废水废气废物处理，以及微生物操作规程、个人防护等方面，符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（2004年第三版，日内瓦）所规定的生物安全三级标准的实验室封闭水平和生物安全处理能力。
2．“生物安全水平四级（BL-4）”是指生物医学或微生物学实验室，使用高效空气粒子过滤器（HEPA），在对外环境保持负压、人员和物品出入实行控制、废水废气废物处理，以及微生物操作规程、个人防护等方面，符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（2004年第三版，日内瓦）所规定的生物安全四级标准的实验室封闭水平和生物安全处理能力。
text.en: 2B352 Biological material processing equipment: a. Complete containment facilities meeting biosafety level 3 (BL-3) or level 4 (BL-4) criteria in the World Health Organization's Laboratory Biosafety Manual, third edition, Geneva, 2004; Notes: 1. “Biosafety level 3 (BL-3)” means the laboratory containment level and biosafety-handling capability of biomedical or microbiological laboratories using high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters and meeting the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual (third edition, Geneva, 2004) level-3 criteria for negative pressure relative to the outside environment, controlled access of people and materials, treatment of wastewater, exhaust air and waste, microbiological procedures, personal protection, and related measures. 2. “Biosafety level 4 (BL-4)” means the laboratory containment level and biosafety-handling capability of biomedical or microbiological laboratories using high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters and meeting the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual (third edition, Geneva, 2004) level-4 criteria for negative pressure relative to the outside environment, controlled access of people and materials, treatment of wastewater, exhaust air and waste, microbiological procedures, personal protection, and related measures.

text.zh:
其特点是在生物安全水平三级的基础上，通过增加气密系统、分隔通道系统，使用三级生物安全柜或正压工作服，以及专用的空气控制系统等，以达到比生物安全水平三级更严密的生物封闭和更高的生物安全处理能力。
b．发酵罐：
1．不泄漏气溶胶，可进行病原微生物培养或毒素生产，且容积大于等于20 L 的发酵罐，包括生物反应器、恒化器和连续灌流系统；
2．对组合顺序有特殊要求或专门设计用于联合系统且容积小于20 L 的发酵罐；
c．具有以下所有特性，不泄漏气溶胶、可对病原微生物进行连续分离的离心分离器（包括倾析器）：
1．在蒸汽密闭区内有一个或多个密闭性连接；
2．流量大于100 L/h；
3．抛光不锈钢或钛部件；
4．密闭状况下可原位蒸汽消毒；
d．交叉流（切向流）过滤设备及其组件：
1．具有以下所有特性，不泄漏气溶胶，可用于分离“病原微生物”“毒素”和细胞培养物的交叉流（切向流）过滤设备：
a．总过滤面积大于等于1 m²；
b．可原位灭菌或消毒；
text.en: It builds on biosafety level 3 by adding airtight systems, segregated access systems, class III biological safety cabinets or positive-pressure suits, and dedicated air-control systems to achieve tighter biological containment and greater biosafety-handling capability than level 3. b. Fermenters: 1. Fermenters that prevent aerosol leakage, are capable of cultivating pathogenic microorganisms or producing toxins, and have a capacity of 20 L or greater, including bioreactors, chemostats, and continuous-perfusion systems; 2. Fermenters with a capacity below 20 L that have special assembly-sequence requirements or are specially designed for integrated systems; c. Centrifugal separators (including decanters) capable of continuous separation of pathogenic microorganisms without aerosol leakage, having all of the following characteristics: 1. One or more sealing joints within the steam-containment area; 2. A flow rate greater than 100 L/h; 3. Polished stainless steel or titanium components; 4. Capable of in-situ steam sterilization while sealed; d. Cross-flow (tangential-flow) filtration equipment and components: 1. Cross-flow (tangential-flow) filtration equipment usable for separating “pathogenic microorganisms,” “toxins,” and cell cultures without aerosol leakage, having all of the following characteristics: a. A total filtration area of 1 m² or greater; b. Capable of in-situ sterilization or disinfection;

text.zh:
技术说明：2B352.d.1.b 项所述的“灭菌”是指通过使用物理（蒸汽）或化学剂杀灭设备中所有的活微生物；“消毒”是指通过使用具有杀菌作用的化学剂，破坏设备中微生物的潜在感染力。“消毒”和“灭菌”不同于“卫生处理”，“卫生处理”是指用于降低设备中微生物含量而不必达到消灭所有微生物感染力或存活力的清洁过程。
2．设计用于2B352.d.1 项所管制的交叉流（切向流）过滤设备，且过滤面积大于等于0.2 m² 的交叉流（切向流）过滤组件（例如：模块、元件、盒子、滤筒、部件或滤板）；
说明：2B352.d 项不管制由制造商标明的反向渗透设备。
e．24 小时凝冰量大于等于10 kg 且小于1000 kg，并可蒸汽消毒的冻干设备；
f．防护设备：
1．依靠外部空气供应，并在正压下操作使用的全身或半身防护服或防护罩；
说明：2B352.f.1 项不管制设计用于与自给式呼吸器配套使用的防护服。
2．三级生物安全柜，
text.en: Technical Note: “Sterilization” in 2B352.d.1.b means killing all viable microorganisms in the equipment using physical agents (steam) or chemical agents; “Disinfection” means destroying the potential infectivity of microorganisms in the equipment using germicidal chemicals. “Disinfection” and “sterilization” differ from “sanitization,” a cleaning process that reduces microbial content in equipment without necessarily eliminating all microbial infectivity or viability. 2. Cross-flow (tangential-flow) filtration components (e.g., modules, elements, cassettes, cartridges, units, or plates) designed for equipment controlled under 2B352.d.1 and having a filtration area of 0.2 m² or greater; Note: 2B352.d does not control equipment identified by the manufacturer as reverse-osmosis equipment. e. Steam-disinfectable freeze-drying equipment with a 24-hour ice-condensing capacity of 10 kg or greater and less than 1000 kg; f. Protective equipment: 1. Full-body or half-body protective suits or hoods dependent on an external air supply and operated under positive pressure; Note: 2B352.f.1 does not control protective suits designed for use with self-contained breathing apparatus. 2. Class III biological safety cabinets,

text.zh:
或具有类似操作标准的隔离装置（例如：柔性隔离装置、干燥箱、厌氧微生物柜、手套箱或层流罩）；
g．用于“病原微生物”“毒素”的气溶胶攻击试验，且容量大于等于1 m³ 的气溶胶吸入设备；
h．喷雾或雾化系统及其组件：
1．专门设计或改进后可安装在轻于航空器的飞行器或“无人驾驶航空器”上的全套喷雾或雾化系统，能够将干粉颗粒以每分钟大于2 L 的流量播散为体积中值直径（VMD）小于50 μm 的初始液滴；
2．专门设计或改进后可安装在2B352.h.1 项所管制飞行器上的气溶胶发生器喷头或多头喷雾组件，能够将干粉颗粒以每分钟大于2L 的流量播散为体积中值直径（VMD）小于50 μm 的初始液滴；
3．专门设计用于安装在符合2B352.h.1、2B352.h.2 项所述标准设备上的气溶胶发生器；
技术说明：
1．“轻于航空器的飞行器”是指依赖热气或轻于空气的气体（例如：氦气或氢气）升空的气球和飞船。
text.en: or isolators with comparable operating standards, such as flexible isolators, dry boxes, anaerobic microorganism cabinets, glove boxes, or laminar-flow hoods; g. Aerosol inhalation equipment with a capacity of 1 m³ or greater for aerosol challenge testing using “pathogenic microorganisms” or “toxins”; h. Spraying or fogging systems and components: 1. Complete spraying or fogging systems specially designed or modified for installation on lighter-than-air vehicles or “unmanned aerial vehicles,” capable of dispersing dry-powder particles as initial droplets with a volume median diameter (VMD) below 50 μm at a flow rate greater than 2 L/min [wording retained from source]; 2. Aerosol-generator spray heads or multihead spray units specially designed or modified for installation on aircraft controlled under 2B352.h.1, capable of dispersing dry-powder particles as initial droplets with a volume median diameter (VMD) below 50 μm at a flow rate greater than 2 L/min [wording retained from source]; 3. Aerosol generators specially designed for installation in equipment meeting the criteria in 2B352.h.1 or 2B352.h.2; Technical Notes: 1. “Lighter-than-air vehicles” means balloons and airships that obtain lift from hot air or lighter-than-air gases, such as helium or hydrogen.

text.zh:
2．“气溶胶发生器”是指专门设计或改进后适合安装在飞行器上的设备，例如喷嘴、转笼式喷头及类似装置。
3．2B352.h 项不管制不能将生物剂以传染性气溶胶形式施放的喷雾或雾化系统及其组件。
4．对专门设计用于飞行器或“无人驾驶航空器”上的喷雾设备或喷嘴所形成的液滴大小，应当使用多普勒激光法或前置激光衍射法测量。
i．用于制备粒子直径1～10 μm 的活微生物和毒素微囊的设备，包括但不限于：
1．界面型多聚凝集器；
2．相分离器；
j．可用于生物安全水平三级或四级防护设施的常规或湍流洁净室、带有风机的高效空气粒子过滤器（HEPA）单元。
text.en: 2. “Aerosol generators” means devices specially designed or modified for installation on aircraft, such as nozzles, rotary-cage atomizers, and similar devices. 3. 2B352.h does not control spraying or fogging systems or their components that cannot disseminate biological agents as infectious aerosols. 4. Droplet size produced by spraying equipment or nozzles specially designed for aircraft or “unmanned aerial vehicles” shall be measured using laser Doppler or forward laser diffraction methods. i. Equipment for preparing microcapsules containing viable microorganisms or toxins with particle diameters of 1–10 μm, including, but not limited to: 1. Interfacial polycondensation equipment; 2. Phase separators; j. Conventional or turbulent-flow cleanrooms and fan-equipped high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filter units usable in biosafety level 3 or 4 containment facilities.

text.zh:
3A101 具有以下任一特性的模/数转换器：
a．在-54～125 ℃的温度范围内连续工作；
b．专门设计以符合加固设备的军用技术规范；
c．专门设计或改进成军用，或设计成抗辐射的，并具有以下任一特性：
1．在额定“精度”下转换速率大于每秒200000 次完整的转换；
2．在规定的工作温度范围内“精度”超过满量程的1/10000以上；
3．品质因数为1×10⁸ 以上（每秒转换次数除以“精度”）；
4．内含具有以下两种特性的模数转换器微型电路：
a．达到最大分辨率时的最长转换时间小于20 μs；
b．在规定的工作温度范围内，额定的非线性度高于满量程的0.025%。
text.en: 3A101 Analog-to-digital converters having any of the following characteristics: a. Continuous operation over a temperature range of -54 to 125 °C; b. Specially designed to meet military specifications for ruggedized equipment; c. Specially designed or modified for military use, or designed to be radiation-hardened, and having any of the following characteristics: 1. A conversion rate greater than 200000 complete conversions per second at rated “accuracy”; 2. “Accuracy” better than 1/10000 of full scale over the specified operating temperature range; 3. A figure of merit of 1×10⁸ or greater (conversions per second divided by “accuracy”); 4. Incorporating analog-to-digital converter microcircuits having both of the following characteristics: a. A maximum conversion time below 20 μs at maximum resolution; b. Rated nonlinearity better than 0.025% of full scale over the specified operating temperature range.

title.zh: 电容器、电磁体和加速器：
title.en: Capacitors, electromagnets, and accelerators:

summary.zh: 电容器、电磁体和加速器：
summary.en: Capacitors, electromagnets, and accelerators:

text.zh:
3A201 电容器、电磁体和加速器：
a．具有以下任何一组特性的脉冲放电电容器：
1．额定电压大于1.4 kV，储能大于10 J，电容大于0.5 µF 和串联电感小于50 nH；
2．额定电压大于750 V，电容大于0.25 µF 和串联电感小于10nH；
b．具有以下所有特性的超导螺线电磁体：
1．能够产生超过2 T 的磁场；
2．长径比（即长度除以内径）超过2；
3．内径超过300 mm；
4．在50%的内部中心空间内，磁场均匀度优于1%；
说明：3A201.b 项不管制为医用核磁共振成像系统（NMR）而专门设计并作为该系统部件出口的磁体。所谓作为该系统部件并不一定是实际同批装运的部件；只要相关出口文件表明这种作为系统部件的关系，也允许此类部件从不同来源单独装运。
c．具有以下任何一组特性的闪光X 射线发生器或脉冲电子加速器：
1．加速器峰值电子能量大于等于500 KeV 且小于25 MeV，品质因数（K）大于等于0.25；
text.en: 3A201 Capacitors, electromagnets, and accelerators: a. Pulse-discharge capacitors having either of the following sets of characteristics: 1. A rated voltage greater than 1.4 kV, stored energy greater than 10 J, capacitance greater than 0.5 µF, and series inductance below 50 nH; 2. A rated voltage greater than 750 V, capacitance greater than 0.25 µF, and series inductance below 10 nH; b. Superconducting solenoidal electromagnets having all of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of producing magnetic fields exceeding 2 T; 2. A length-to-inside-diameter ratio exceeding 2; 3. An inside diameter exceeding 300 mm; 4. Magnetic-field uniformity better than 1% over the central 50% of the internal volume; Note: 3A201.b does not control magnets specially designed for medical nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) imaging systems and exported as components of those systems. A component of such a system need not be physically shipped in the same consignment; Separate shipments of such components from different sources are permitted if the relevant export documentation establishes their relationship as system components. c. Flash X-ray generators or pulsed electron accelerators having either of the following sets of characteristics: 1. An accelerator peak electron energy of 500 keV or greater and less than 25 MeV, and a figure of merit (K) of 0.25 or greater;

text.zh:
2．加速器峰值电子能量大于等于25 MeV，峰值功率大于50MW。
说明：3A201.c 项不管制以下加速器：
1．作为电子束或X 射线辐射以外用途仪器（例如：电子显微镜）零部件的加速器；
2．作为医用装置零部件的加速器。
技术说明：
1．品质因数K 定义为K＝1.7×10³V^(2.65)Q。V 是峰值电子能量（单位：百万电子伏），如果加速器电子束脉冲宽度小于或等于1 µs 时间，则Q 为总的加速电荷（单位：库仑）；如果加速器电子束脉冲宽度大于1 µs 时，则Q 为1 µs 内的最大加速电荷。Q 等于i 对t 的积分，时间区间在1 µs 或电子束脉冲宽度，两者中取较小者（Q＝∫idt），公式中i 是电子束电流（单位：A），t 是时间（单位：s）。
2．峰值功率＝峰值电位（单位：V）×电子束峰值电流（单位：A）。
3．电子束脉冲时间宽度：在用微波加速腔的加速器里，电子束脉冲时间宽度是1 µs
text.en: 2. An accelerator peak electron energy of 25 MeV or greater, and a peak power greater than 50 MW. Note: 3A201.c does not control the following accelerators: 1. Accelerators that are components of instruments designed for purposes other than electron-beam or X-ray radiation (e.g., electron microscopes); 2. Accelerators that are components of medical devices. Technical Notes: 1. The figure of merit K is defined as K = 1.7×10³ V^(2.65)Q. V is the peak electron energy in MeV. If the accelerator electron-beam pulse width is 1 µs or less, Q is the total accelerated charge in coulombs; if the accelerator electron-beam pulse width exceeds 1 µs, Q is the maximum charge accelerated within 1 µs. Q equals the integral of i with respect to t over 1 µs or the electron-beam pulse width, whichever is shorter (Q = ∫i dt), where i is the electron-beam current in A and t is time in s. 2. Peak power = peak potential in V × peak electron-beam current in A. 3. Electron-beam pulse duration: in accelerators using microwave accelerating cavities, the electron-beam pulse duration is 1 µs

text.zh:
或是微波调制器一个脉冲产生的聚束团的持续时间，两者中取较小者。
4．电子束峰值电流：在用微波加速腔的加速器里，电子束峰值电流为聚束团持续时间内的平均电流。
text.en: or the duration of the electron bunch packet produced by one microwave-modulator pulse, whichever is shorter. 4. Peak electron-beam current: in accelerators using microwave accelerating cavities, the peak electron-beam current is the average current over the duration of the electron bunch packet.

text.zh:
3A225 具有以下所有特性，可作为变频或固定频率电机驱动装置使用的频率变换器或发电机：注意1：为气体离心过程专门设计或配备的变频器和发电机按照《中华人民共和国核出口管制清单》加以管制。注意2：为增强或发挥频率变化器或发电机的性能以符合以下特性而专门设计的软件受3D224 和3D225 项管制。
a．提供40 VA 或更高功率的多相输出；
b．在大于等于600 Hz 的频率范围内工作；
c．频率控制优于0.2%。
说明：
1．如果用于特定工业机械或消费品（机床、车辆等）的频率变换器符合上述特性，且可被拆卸、移作他用，则需按3A225 项加以管制。
2．需综合考虑硬件及软件情况，判定频率变换器是否符合上述特性。
技术说明：
1．3A225 项所管制的频率变换器亦是通常所称的变频器或逆变器。
2．市场上其他设备，可能符合3A225 项所述特性，
text.en: 3A225 Frequency converters or generators usable as variable-frequency or fixed-frequency motor drives, having all of the following characteristics: N.B. 1: Frequency converters and generators specially designed or prepared for the gas-centrifuge process are controlled under the Nuclear Export Control List of the People's Republic of China. N.B. 2: Software specially designed to enhance or release the performance of frequency converters or generators to meet the following characteristics is controlled under 3D224 and 3D225. a. Multiphase output providing 40 VA or greater; b. Operating in a frequency range of 600 Hz or greater; c. Frequency control better than 0.2%. Notes: 1. Frequency converters used in specific industrial machinery or consumer products (machine tools, vehicles, etc.) are controlled under 3A225 if they meet the above characteristics and can be removed and used for other purposes. 2. Both hardware and software must be considered when determining whether a frequency converter meets the above characteristics. Technical Notes: 1. Frequency converters controlled under 3A225 are also commonly called frequency inverters or inverters. 2. Other commercially available equipment may meet the characteristics specified in 3A225,

text.zh:
3A229 点火装置和等效大电流脉冲发生器：
a．引爆多个3A232 项所管制的雷管用炸药雷管点火装置（起爆系统、点火装置），包括带电、爆炸驱动和光学驱动的点火装置；
b．具有以下所有特性的模块式电脉冲发生器（脉冲源）：
1．设计成便携式、可移动或加固型；
2．能够在不足15 µs 时间内将能量输入小于40 Ω的负载；
3．输出电流大于100 A；
4．任何尺寸不超过30 cm；
5．重量小于30 kg；
6．专用于宽温度范围（-50～100 ℃），或专用于宇航；
c．具有以下所有特性的微型点火装置：
1．任何尺寸不超过35 mm；
2．额定电压大于等于1 kV；
3．电容大于等于100 nF。
说明：光学驱动的点火装置管制采用激光起爆和激光充电的装置。爆炸驱动的点火装置管制爆炸铁电和爆炸铁磁点火装置类型。3A229.b 项管制氙闪光灯驱动器。
text.en: 3A229 Firing sets and equivalent high-current pulse generators: a. Explosive-detonator firing sets (initiation systems, firing devices) for initiating multiple detonators controlled under 3A232, including electrically charged, explosively driven, and optically driven firing sets; b. Modular electrical pulse generators (pulsers) having all of the following characteristics: 1. Designed to be portable, mobile, or ruggedized; 2. Capable of delivering energy in less than 15 µs into a load below 40 Ω; 3. An output current greater than 100 A; 4. No dimension exceeding 30 cm; 5. A weight below 30 kg; 6. Specified for a wide temperature range (-50 to 100 °C) or for aerospace use; c. Micro-firing units having all of the following characteristics: 1. No dimension exceeding 35 mm; 2. A rated voltage of 1 kV or greater; 3. A capacitance of 100 nF or greater. Note: Optically driven firing sets include laser-initiated and laser-charged devices. Explosively driven firing sets include explosive ferroelectric and explosive ferromagnetic types. 3A229.b controls xenon flashlamp drivers.

技术说明：

2．“脉冲头”是指为接受电压阶跃函数并使之形成可包括矩形脉冲、三角形脉冲、阶跃脉冲、冲击脉冲、指数脉冲或单周期脉冲等各类脉冲形式而设计的脉冲形成网络。“脉冲头”可以是脉冲发生器的一个整体组成部分或该装置的一个插件模块，也可以是一个外部连接装置。
text.en: 3A230 High-speed pulse generators and their “pulse heads,” having both of the following characteristics: a. An output voltage greater than 6 V into a resistive load below 55 Ω; b. A “pulse transition time” below 500 ps. Technical Notes: 1. In 3A230.b, “pulse transition time” means the time interval during which the voltage amplitude increases from 10% to 90%. 2. “Pulse heads” means pulse-forming networks designed to accept a voltage step function and shape it into various pulse forms, including rectangular, triangular, step, impulse, exponential, or monocycle pulses. A “pulse head” may be an integral component of a pulse generator, a plug-in module, or an externally connected device.

title.zh: 雷管和多点起爆系统：
title.en: Detonators and multipoint initiation systems:

summary.zh: 雷管和多点起爆系统：
summary.en: Detonators and multipoint initiation systems:

text.zh:
3A232 雷管和多点起爆系统：
a．电驱动的炸药雷管：
1．爆炸桥（EB）；
2．爆炸桥丝（EBW）；
3．冲击片；
4．爆炸箔起爆器（EFI）；
b．使用单个或多个雷管的装置，设计成可由单一的点火信号几乎同时（传遍炸药面到起爆的时间小于2.5 µs）起爆炸药面（其面积超过5000mm²）。
说明：3A232 项不管制仅使用起爆药（例如：叠氮化铅）的雷管。
技术说明：3A232 项所管制的雷管均利用一个小导电体（例如：桥、桥丝或箔），当上升时间短的大电流电脉冲通过上述导电体时，使它爆炸而汽化。在非冲击片型雷管里，爆炸的导电体引起相接触的高能炸药如太安（PETN，季戊四醇四硝酸酯）化学爆轰。在冲击片型雷管里，导电体的爆炸蒸汽驱动飞片或冲击片飞过一个间隙，撞击炸药而引起化学爆轰。在某些设计中，冲击片是由磁力驱动。术语爆炸箔雷管，可以指爆炸桥雷管，或指冲击片型雷管。起爆器有时也被用来代替雷管。
text.en: 3A232 Detonators and multipoint initiation systems: a. Electrically driven explosive detonators: 1. Exploding bridge (EB); 2. Exploding bridgewire (EBW); 3. Slapper; 4. Exploding foil initiator (EFI); b. Devices using single or multiple detonators designed to initiate an explosive surface exceeding 5000 mm² almost simultaneously from a single firing signal, with a spread of initiation times across the surface of less than 2.5 µs. Note: 3A232 does not control detonators using only primary explosives, such as lead azide. Technical Note: Detonators controlled under 3A232 use a small electrical conductor, such as a bridge, bridgewire, or foil, which explosively vaporizes when a high-current electrical pulse with a short rise time passes through it. In nonslapper detonators, the exploding conductor initiates chemical detonation in a high explosive in contact with it, such as PETN (pentaerythritol tetranitrate). In slapper detonators, the explosive vaporization of the conductor drives a flyer or slapper across a gap to strike the explosive and initiate chemical detonation. In some designs, the slapper is magnetically driven. The term exploding-foil detonator may refer to an exploding-bridge detonator or a slapper-type detonator. The term initiator is sometimes used instead of detonator.

text.en: 3A233 Mass spectrometers capable of measuring ions of 230 u or greater with a resolution better than 2/230, and ion sources therefor: N.B.: Mass spectrometers specially designed or manufactured for analyzing on-line uranium-hexafluoride samples are controlled under the Nuclear Export Control List of the People's Republic of China. a. Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometers (ICP/MS); b. Glow-discharge mass spectrometers (GDMS); c. Thermal-ionization mass spectrometers (TIMS); d. Electron-bombardment mass spectrometers having both of the following characteristics: 1. A molecular-beam inlet system that injects a collimated beam of analyte molecules into the ion-source region where an electron beam ionizes the molecules; 2. One or more “cold traps” capable of cooling to -80 °C or lower to trap analyte molecules not ionized by the electron beam; e. Mass spectrometers designed for actinides or actinide fluorides and equipped with microfluorination ion sources. Technical Notes: 1. 3A233.d controls mass spectrometers typically used for isotope analysis of uranium-hexafluoride gas samples. 2. Electron-bombardment mass spectrometers controlled under 3A233.d are also called electron-impact or electron-ionization mass spectrometers. 3. In 3A233.d.2,

text.zh: “冷阱”是一种通过将气体分子凝结或冻结在冷的表面上来捕集气体分子的装置。就本项而言，闭环气态氦低温真空泵不是“冷阱”。
text.en: a “cold trap” is a device that traps gas molecules by condensing or freezing them onto a cold surface. For this item, a closed-loop gaseous-helium cryogenic vacuum pump is not a “cold trap.”

text.zh:
4A003 高性能“数字计算机”、电子组件及相关设备：
a．“调整后的峰值性能（APP）”大于8.0 加权每秒万亿次浮点运算（Weighted TeraFLOPS）的“数字计算机”；
b．为增强性能而专门设计或改装的“电子组件”，其采用处理器聚合方式以使“调整后的峰值性能（APP）”大于8.0 加权每秒万亿次浮点运算（Weighted TeraFLOPS）；
c．为聚合“数字计算机”性能而专门设计的外部互连设备，其单链路单向通信速率超过2.0 Gbyte/s，但不适用于内部互连设备（例如：背板、总线）、无源互连设备、网络访问控制器或通信信道控制器。
技术说明：调整后的峰值性能（APP）是指“数字计算机”在进行64 位或更多位的浮点加法和乘法运算的调整后的峰值速度。本技术说明涉及的缩写：n“数字计算机”中的处理器数量I 处理器编号（1，……，n）tᵢ 处理器时钟周期（tᵢ=1/Fᵢ）Fᵢ 处理器频率Rᵢ 峰值浮点运算速度Wᵢ
text.en: 4A003 High-performance “digital computers,” electronic assemblies, and related equipment: a. “Digital computers” with an “adjusted peak performance (APP)” exceeding 8.0 weighted tera floating-point operations per second (Weighted TeraFLOPS); b. “Electronic assemblies” specially designed or modified to enhance performance by aggregating processors to achieve an “adjusted peak performance (APP)” exceeding 8.0 Weighted TeraFLOPS; c. External interconnection equipment specially designed to aggregate the performance of “digital computers,” with a unidirectional communication rate per link exceeding 2.0 Gbyte/s; this does not apply to internal interconnection equipment (e.g., backplanes or buses), passive interconnection equipment, network access controllers, or communication channel controllers. Technical Note: Adjusted peak performance (APP) means the adjusted peak rate at which “digital computers” perform floating-point addition and multiplication operations of 64 bits or more. Abbreviations used in this Technical Note: n = number of processors in the “digital computer”; i = processor index (1, …, n); tᵢ = processor clock cycle (tᵢ = 1/Fᵢ); Fᵢ = processor frequency; Rᵢ = peak floating-point operating rate; Wᵢ =

1. 确定“数字计算机”中的每个处理器i 在每个时钟周期内执行的64 位或更多位的峰值浮点操作次数（FPOᵢ）。
说明：在确定FPO 时，仅包括64 位或更多位浮点加法、浮点乘法运算。所有浮点运算必须表示为每个处理器时钟周期所执行的运算次数；需要多个时钟周期完成的运算可以表示为每个时钟周期完成运算的分数值。对于不能进行64 位或更多位浮点操作数的处理器，其有效浮点运算速度R 为0。
2. 计算每个处理器的浮点运算速度R，Rᵢ= FPOᵢ/ tᵢ
3. 计算APP，APP=W₁×R₁+ W₂×R₂+…+ Wₙ×Rₙ
4. 对于“向量处理器”，Wᵢ=0.9；对于非“向量处理器”，Wᵢ=0.3说明1：对于在一个时钟周期内能够完成复合运算的处理器，例如同时进行加法和乘法运算，
text.en: architecture adjustment factor. APP is expressed in Weighted TeraFLOPS (WT), in units of 10¹² adjusted floating-point operations per second. APP is calculated as follows: 1. Determine the peak number of floating-point operations of 64 bits or more performed per clock cycle by each processor i in the “digital computer” (FPOᵢ). Note: In determining FPO, include only floating-point addition and multiplication operations of 64 bits or more. All floating-point operations must be expressed as the number performed per processor clock cycle; operations requiring multiple clock cycles may be expressed as fractions of an operation per clock cycle. For processors incapable of operating on floating-point operands of 64 bits or more, the effective floating-point operating rate R is zero. 2. Calculate each processor's floating-point operating rate R: Rᵢ = FPOᵢ/tᵢ. 3. Calculate APP: APP = W₁×R₁ + W₂×R₂ + … + Wₙ×Rₙ. 4. For “vector processors,” Wᵢ = 0.9; for non-“vector processors,” Wᵢ = 0.3. Note 1: For processors capable of compound operations in one clock cycle, such as simultaneous addition and multiplication,

技术说明：
1．聚合在同一芯片上的所有同时运行的处理器和加速器；
2．处理器组合共享内存方式，
text.en: count all operations. Note 2: For pipelined processors, the effective floating-point operating rate R is the higher of the fully loaded pipeline rate and the nonpipelined rate. Note 3: Before calculating APP, calculate the operating rate R of each participating processor at its maximum theoretical value. If the computer manufacturer states in manuals or literature that the computer can operate concurrently, in parallel, or simultaneously, simultaneous operation must be considered when calculating R. Note 4: Exclude processors dedicated solely to input/output and peripheral functions, such as disk drives, communications, and video displays, when calculating APP. Note 5: Exclude processor combinations interconnected through “local area networks,” wide area networks, shared I/O connections or devices, I/O controllers, or any software-implemented communication interconnection when calculating APP. Note 6: Include processor combinations specially designed to enhance system performance through aggregation, simultaneous operation, and shared memory when calculating APP. Technical Notes: 1. Aggregate all simultaneously operating processors and accelerators on the same chip; 2. Shared memory for a processor combination means

text.zh: 是任一处理器通过高速缓存块或存储字的硬件传输、不用任何的软件机制可以访问系统中的任一内存地址。该方式可以通过4A003.b 所管制的“电子组件”获得。说明7：“向量处理器”定义为内置向量指令的处理器，这些指令能够同时进行多重浮点向量（64 位或更多位的一维数组）运算，且处理器中至少含有2 个向量功能部件和至少8 个向量寄存器，每个向量寄存器至少包含64 个数据单元。

This may be achieved through “electronic assemblies” controlled under 4A003.b. Note 7: A “vector processor” is a processor with built-in vector instructions capable of simultaneously performing multiple operations on floating-point vectors (one-dimensional arrays of 64 bits or more), with at least two vector functional units and at least eight vector registers, each containing at least 64 data elements.

text.zh:
5A002 信息安全系统、设备及其部件：
a．具有以下任一特性，部分或全部实现了密码运算、密钥管理、随机数生成等功能的集成电路芯片（安全芯片）：
1．含有专门用于电力、税务、公安、金融等领域的64 位以上密钥长度的对称密码算法，768 位以上密钥长度的基于整数因子分解的非对称密码算法或128 位以上密钥长度基于椭圆曲线的非对称密码算法；
2．含有64 位以上密钥长度的对称密码算法、768 位以上密钥长度的基于整数因子分解的非对称密码算法或128 位以上密钥长度基于椭圆曲线的非对称密码算法，且对称密码算法加解密速率10Gbps 以上或非对称密码算法签名速率50000 tps 以上；
b．具有以下两种特性，以实现密码运算为主要功能的设备（密码机、密码卡）：
1．含有64 位以上密钥长度的对称密码算法、768 位以上密钥长度的基于整数因子分解的非对称密码算法或128 位以上密钥长度基于椭圆曲线的非对称密码算法；
text.en: 5A002 Information-security systems, equipment, and components: a. Integrated-circuit chips (security chips) implementing, in whole or in part, cryptographic operations, key management, random-number generation, or similar functions, and having either of the following characteristics: 1. Contains symmetric cryptographic algorithms with key lengths of at least 64 bits, asymmetric algorithms based on integer factorization with key lengths of at least 768 bits, or elliptic-curve asymmetric algorithms with key lengths of at least 128 bits, dedicated to fields such as electric power, taxation, public security, or finance; 2. Contains symmetric cryptographic algorithms with key lengths of at least 64 bits, asymmetric algorithms based on integer factorization with key lengths of at least 768 bits, or elliptic-curve asymmetric algorithms with key lengths of at least 128 bits, and has a symmetric encryption/decryption rate of at least 10 Gbps or an asymmetric signature rate of at least 50000 tps; b. Equipment whose primary function is cryptographic processing (cryptographic machines or cards), having both of the following characteristics: 1. a．雷达设备：

text.en: 6A108 Target-detection electronic devices and components: a. Radar equipment: b. Terrain-contour mapping equipment; c. Scene-mapping and related equipment, including digital and analog equipment; d. Imaging sensor equipment; e. Electronic devices and components that remove heat by conduction; f. "Radiation-hardened" electronic devices and components; g. Electronic devices and components capable of reliable short-term operation at temperatures above 125 °C; h. Electronic devices and components with specially designed integral structural supports. Note: 6A108 does not control target-detection electronic devices and components integrated into civil aircraft, including civil airplanes and general-aviation aircraft. Where this List otherwise provides for export controls on "unmanned aerial vehicles" and related items, those provisions apply.

a．以下扫描相机和为其专门设计的部件：
1．记录速度大于0.5 mm/μs 的扫描相机；
2．时间分辨率能够小于等于50 ns 的电子扫描相机；

b．以下分幅相机和为其专门设计的部件：
1．记录速率大于每秒225000 帧的分幅相机；
2．帧曝光时间能够小于等于50 ns 的分幅相机；
3．为6A203.b.1 或6A203.b.2 项所管制相机专门设计，且选通（快门）时间小于等于50 ns

Plug-ins specially designed for use with modular streak cameras meeting the performance specifications of 6A203.a.1 or 6A203.a.2; 5. Synchronization electronics and rotating assemblies consisting of turbines, mirrors, and bearings, specially designed for cameras controlled under 6A203.a.1. b. The following framing cameras and specially designed components therefor: 1. Framing cameras with recording rates greater than 225000 frames per second; 2. title.zh: 激光器、激光放大器和振荡器：
title.en: Lasers, laser amplifiers, and oscillators:

summary.zh: 激光器、激光放大器和振荡器：
summary.en: Lasers, laser amplifiers, and oscillators:

text.zh:
6A205 激光器、激光放大器和振荡器：
a．具有以下两种特性的铜蒸气激光器：
1．工作波长500～600 nm；
2．“平均输出功率”大于等于30 W；
b．具有以下两种特性的氩离子激光器：
1．工作波长400～515 nm；
2．“平均输出功率”大于等于40 W；
c．具有以下任一特性，输出波长1000～1100 nm 的掺钕的激光器（非玻璃激光器）：
1．采用脉冲激发和Q-开关，其脉冲宽度大于等于1 ns，并具有以下任一特性：
a．单横模输出，“平均输出功率”超过40 W；
b．多横模输出，“平均输出功率”超过50 W；
2．倍频后，输出波长500～550 nm，倍频（新波长）“平均输出功率”超过40 W；
d．具有以下所有特性的可调脉冲单模染料激光振荡器：
1．工作波长300～800 nm；
2．“平均输出功率”超过1 W；
3．重复率超过1 kHz；
4．脉冲宽度小于100 ns；
text.en: 6A205 Lasers, laser amplifiers, and oscillators: a. Copper-vapor lasers having both of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 500–600 nm; 2. “Average output power” of 30 W or greater; b. Argon-ion lasers having both of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 400–515 nm; 2. “Average output power” of 40 W or greater; c. Neodymium-doped lasers, other than glass lasers, with an output wavelength of 1000–1100 nm and either of the following characteristics: 1. Pulse-excited and Q-switched, with a pulse duration of 1 ns or greater and either of the following characteristics: a. Single-transverse-mode output with “average output power” exceeding 40 W; b. Multiple-transverse-mode output with “average output power” exceeding 50 W; 2. After frequency doubling, an output wavelength of 500–550 nm and frequency-doubled “average output power” at the new wavelength exceeding 40 W; d. Tunable pulsed single-mode dye-laser oscillators having all of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 300–800 nm; 2. “Average output power” exceeding 1 W; 3. A repetition rate exceeding 1 kHz; 4. A pulse duration below 100 ns;

text.zh:
e．具有以下所有特性的可调脉冲染料激光放大器和振荡器：
1．工作波长300～800 nm；
2．“平均输出功率”超过30 W；
3．重复率超过1 kHz；
4．脉冲宽度小于100 ns；
说明：6A205.e 项不管制单模振荡器。
f．具有以下所有特性的紫翠玉激光器：
1．工作波长720～800 nm；
2．带宽大于等于0.005 nm；
3．重复率超过125 Hz；
4．“平均输出功率”超过30 W；
g．具有以下所有特性的脉冲二氧化碳激光器：
1．工作波长9000～11000 nm；
2．重复率超过250 Hz；
3．“平均输出功率”超过500 W；
4．脉冲宽度小于200 ns；
说明：6A205.g 项不管制诸如切割和焊接中应用的更高功率（通常为1～5 kW）工业用二氧化碳激光器，因为这类激光器采用的是连续波，或是脉冲宽度超过200 ns 的脉冲。
h．具有以下所有特性的脉冲受激准分子激光器（氟化氙、氯化氙和氟化氪）：
text.en: e. Tunable pulsed dye-laser amplifiers and oscillators having all of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 300–800 nm; 2. “Average output power” exceeding 30 W; 3. A repetition rate exceeding 1 kHz; 4. A pulse duration below 100 ns; Note: 6A205.e does not control single-mode oscillators. f. Alexandrite lasers having all of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 720–800 nm; 2. A bandwidth of 0.005 nm or greater; 3. A repetition rate exceeding 125 Hz; 4. “Average output power” exceeding 30 W; g. Pulsed carbon-dioxide lasers having all of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 9000–11000 nm; 2. A repetition rate exceeding 250 Hz; 3. “Average output power” exceeding 500 W; 4. A pulse duration below 200 ns; Note: 6A205.g does not control higher-power industrial carbon-dioxide lasers, typically 1–5 kW, used for applications such as cutting and welding, because they operate in continuous-wave mode or with pulse durations exceeding 200 ns. h. Pulsed excimer lasers (xenon fluoride, xenon chloride, and krypton fluoride) having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh:
1．工作波长240～360 nm；
2．重复率超过250 Hz；
3．“平均输出功率”超过500 W；
i．设计输出波长为16 µm、重复率超过250 Hz 的仲氢喇曼移相器；
j．具有以下所有特性的脉冲一氧化碳激光器：
1．工作波长5000～6000 nm；
2．重复率超过250 Hz；
3．“平均输出功率”超过200 W；
4．脉冲宽度小于200 ns。
说明：6A205.j 项不管制诸如切割和焊接中应用的更高功率（通常为1～5 kW）工业用一氧化碳激光器，因为这类激光器采用的是连续波，或是脉冲宽度超过200 ns 的脉冲。
text.en: 1. An operating wavelength of 240–360 nm; 2. A repetition rate exceeding 250 Hz; 3. “Average output power” exceeding 500 W; i. Parahydrogen Raman shifters designed for an output wavelength of 16 µm and a repetition rate exceeding 250 Hz; j. Pulsed carbon-monoxide lasers having all of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 5000–6000 nm; 2. A repetition rate exceeding 250 Hz; 3. “Average output power” exceeding 200 W; 4. A pulse duration below 200 ns. Note: 6A205.j does not control higher-power industrial carbon-monoxide lasers, typically 1–5 kW, used for applications such as cutting and welding, because they operate in continuous-wave mode or with pulse durations exceeding 200 ns.

text.zh:
6A225 用于在小于10 µs 的时间间隔内测量速度超过1 km/s的速度干涉仪。
说明：6A225 项管制诸如适用于任意反射体的速度干涉仪系统（VISARs）、多普勒激光干涉仪（DLIs）和光子多普勒测速仪（PDV，也称外差测速仪Het-V）等速度干涉仪。
text.en: 6A225 Velocity interferometers for measuring velocities exceeding 1 km/s over time intervals below 10 µs. Note: 6A225 controls velocity interferometers such as velocity interferometer systems for any reflector (VISARs), Doppler laser interferometers (DLIs), and photonic Doppler velocimeters (PDVs, also called heterodyne velocimeters, Het-V).

title.en: Dredgers:

summary.zh: 挖泥船：
summary.en: Dredgers:

text.zh:
8A901 挖泥船：
a．具有以下任一特性的耙吸式挖泥船：
1．“舱容”大于等于1500 m³；
2．“挖深”大于等于15 m；
3．具有艏吹功能及装置；
b．具有以下任一特性的绞吸式挖泥船：
1．“绞刀功率”大于等于500 kW；
2．“挖深”大于等于15 m；
3．“总装机功率”大于等于2000 kW；
c．具有以下任一特性的斗式挖泥船：
1．“斗容”大于等于4 m³；
2．“挖深”大于等于15 m；
d．具有以下任一特性的吸沙船：
1．“舱容”大于等于500 m³；
2．“总装机功率”大于等于1000 kW；
e．具有以下任一特性的自航自卸式泥驳：
1．“舱容”大于等于1000 m³；
2．具有艏吹功能及自卸装置。
技术说明：就8A901 而言，“舱容”是指挖泥船泥舱的有效容积；“挖深”是指挖泥船作业时最大挖深；“绞刀功率”是指绞吸式挖泥船绞刀工作所需的输入功率；“总装机功率”是指船上所有柴油机及电池输出功率之和；
text.en: 8A901 Dredgers: a. Trailing suction hopper dredgers having any of the following characteristics: 1. A “hopper capacity” of 1500 m³ or greater; 2. A “dredging depth” of 15 m or greater; 3. Bow-discharge capability and equipment; b. Cutter-suction dredgers having any of the following characteristics: 1. “Cutter power” of 500 kW or greater; 2. A “dredging depth” of 15 m or greater; 3. “Total installed power” of 2000 kW or greater; c. Bucket dredgers having either of the following characteristics: 1. A “bucket capacity” of 4 m³ or greater; 2. A “dredging depth” of 15 m or greater; d. Sand-suction vessels having either of the following characteristics: 1. A “hopper capacity” of 500 m³ or greater; 2. “Total installed power” of 1000 kW or greater; e. Self-propelled, self-unloading hopper barges having either of the following characteristics: 1. A “hopper capacity” of 1000 m³ or greater; 2. Bow-discharge capability and self-unloading equipment. Technical Note: For 8A901, “hopper capacity” means the effective volume of the dredger's spoil hopper; “dredging depth” means the maximum dredging depth during operation; “cutter power” means the input power required to operate the cutter of a cutter-suction dredger; “total installed power” means the combined output power of all diesel engines and batteries on board;

text.zh: “斗容”是指斗式挖泥船的抓斗或链斗的总容积。
text.en: “bucket capacity” means the total volume of the grab or chain buckets of a bucket dredger.

title.zh: “无人驾驶航空器”“无人驾驶飞艇”以及相关设备和部件：
title.en: “Unmanned aerial vehicles,” “unmanned airships,” and related equipment and components:

summary.zh: “无人驾驶航空器”“无人驾驶飞艇”以及相关设备和部件：
summary.en: “Unmanned aerial vehicles,” “unmanned airships,” and related equipment and components:

text.zh:
9A012 “无人驾驶航空器”“无人驾驶飞艇”以及相关设备和部件：
a．在“操作人员”“自然视距”以外能够可控飞行并具有以下任一特性的“无人驾驶航空器”或“无人驾驶飞艇”：
1．最大“续航时间”大于等于30 分钟小于1h，以及在大于等于46.3 km/h（25 节）的阵风条件下，具有起飞能力和稳定可控飞行能力；
2．最大“续航时间”大于等于1h；
技术说明：
1．“操作人员”是指负责操控“无人驾驶航空器”或“无人驾驶飞艇”的专业人员，通过地面控制站对飞行器进行遥控或编程，以确保飞行任务的顺利完成；
2．“续航时间”指换算到国际标准大气环境条件（ISO2533：1975）下海平面零风状态的持续飞行时间；
3．“自然视距”是指在没有任何人为干扰和大气污染的理想条件下，地球表面上观察者能够清晰看到物体的最大距离。视距是指在地球表面上，由于地球曲率的限制，观察者能够清晰看到物体的最大距离。在实际应用中，通常考虑大气条件对视距的影响。
text.en: 9A012 “Unmanned aerial vehicles,” “unmanned airships,” and related equipment and components: a. “Unmanned aerial vehicles” or “unmanned airships” capable of controlled flight beyond the “operator's” “natural line of sight,” having either of the following characteristics: 1. A maximum “endurance” of 30 minutes or greater but less than 1 h, and the ability to take off and maintain stable, controlled flight in wind gusts of 46.3 km/h (25 knots) or greater; 2. A maximum “endurance” of 1 h or greater; Technical Notes: 1. “Operator” means the professional responsible for controlling an “unmanned aerial vehicle” or “unmanned airship” through remote control or programming via a ground-control station to ensure successful completion of the flight mission; 2. “Endurance” means continuous flight time converted to sea-level, zero-wind conditions under the International Standard Atmosphere (ISO 2533:1975); 3. “Natural line of sight” means the maximum distance at which an observer on the Earth's surface can clearly see an object under ideal conditions without human interference or atmospheric pollution. Line of sight means the maximum distance at which an observer on the Earth's surface can clearly see an object, as limited by the Earth's curvature. In practice, the effect of atmospheric conditions on line of sight is normally considered.

text.zh:
b．用于“无人驾驶航空器”或“无人驾驶飞艇”的发动机：
1．设计或改进后用于在15420 m（50000 英尺）以上“高空”飞行的吸气活塞式或转子式内燃发动机；
2．最大持续功率超过16 kW 的航空发动机；
c．满足一定技术指标的专门用于9A012.a 项所管制的“无人驾驶航空器”或“无人驾驶飞艇”的“载荷”，包括“红外成像设备”、“合成孔径雷达”、“目标指示激光器”、惯性测量设备：
1．具有以下两种特性的“红外成像设备”：
a．波长范围780～30000 nm；
b．“瞬时视场角”（IFOV）小于2.5 mrad；
2．作用距离大于5 km，且具有以下任一特性的“合成孔径雷达”（SAR）：
a．“条带模式”分辨率优于0.3 m；
b．“聚束模式”分辨率优于0.1 m；
3．可在高于55℃环境中稳定工作，且具有以下所有特性的“目标指示激光器”：
a．免温控型；
b．能量大于80 mJ；
c．稳定度优于15%；
text.en: b. Engines for “unmanned aerial vehicles” or “unmanned airships”: 1. Air-breathing piston or rotary internal-combustion engines designed or modified for “high-altitude” flight above 15420 m (50000 feet); 2. Aircraft engines with a maximum continuous power exceeding 16 kW; c. “Payloads” meeting specified technical criteria and dedicated to “unmanned aerial vehicles” or “unmanned airships” controlled under 9A012.a, including “infrared imaging equipment,” “synthetic aperture radar,” “target-designating lasers,” and inertial measurement equipment: 1. “Infrared imaging equipment” having both of the following characteristics: a. A wavelength range of 780–30000 nm; b. An “instantaneous field of view” (IFOV) below 2.5 mrad; 2. “Synthetic aperture radar” (SAR) with an operating range greater than 5 km and either of the following characteristics: a. “Stripmap mode” resolution better than 0.3 m; b. “Spotlight mode” resolution better than 0.1 m; 3. “Target-designating lasers” capable of stable operation at ambient temperatures above 55 °C and having all of the following characteristics: a. No temperature control required; b. Energy greater than 80 mJ; c. Stability better than 15%;

text.zh:
d．“光束发散角”小于0.3 mrad；
4．具有以下所有特性的惯性测量设备：
a．航向精度小于2°；
b．姿态精度小于0.5°；
c．分辨率小于0.1°；
说明：9A012.c.4 项不管制7A、7B 所管制的相关物项。
d．专门设计用于将有人飞行器、有人驾驶飞艇改装为9A012.a项所管制的“无人驾驶航空器”“无人驾驶飞艇”的设备或部件；
e．专门用于9A012.a 项所管制的“无人驾驶航空器”或“无人驾驶飞艇”，且具有以下任一特性的无线电通信设备：
1．“无线电视距”传输距离大于50 km；
2．一站控多机能力大于10 架。
说明：9A012.a、9A012.b.1、9A012.d 项不管制模型飞机或模型飞艇。
技术说明：就9A012 项而言：
1．“红外成像设备”是一种利用物体发射的红外辐射来形成图像的探测设备，广泛应用于夜视、热成像、搜索与救援等领域。
2．“合成孔径雷达”是一种主动式微波遥感系统，
text.en: d. “Beam divergence” below 0.3 mrad; 4. Inertial measurement equipment having all of the following characteristics: a. Heading accuracy below 2°; b. Attitude accuracy below 0.5°; c. Resolution below 0.1°; Note: 9A012.c.4 does not control related items controlled under 7A or 7B. d. Equipment or components specially designed to convert manned aircraft or manned airships into “unmanned aerial vehicles” or “unmanned airships” controlled under 9A012.a; e. Radio communication equipment dedicated to “unmanned aerial vehicles” or “unmanned airships” controlled under 9A012.a, having either of the following characteristics: 1. A “radio line-of-sight” transmission distance greater than 50 km; 2. The capability to control more than 10 aircraft from a single station. Note: 9A012.a, 9A012.b.1, and 9A012.d do not control model aircraft or model airships. Technical Notes: For 9A012: 1. “Infrared imaging equipment” means detection equipment that forms images using infrared radiation emitted by objects, widely used for night vision, thermal imaging, search and rescue, and similar applications. 2. “Synthetic aperture radar” is an active microwave remote-sensing system

text.zh:
它通过合成孔径技术获得高分辨率雷达图像，适用于地形测绘、环境监测等。
3．“目标指示激光器”是一种用于军事领域的激光设备，它能精确地指向目标并对其进行标记，以便于激光制导武器对其进行打击。
4．“瞬时视场角”是指探测器在某一瞬间所能覆盖的视场角度，它决定了探测器的空间分辨率。
5．“条带模式”是合成孔径雷达工作的一种模式，其中雷达波束沿着飞行方向连续扫描地面，形成一条宽的扫描带。
6．“聚束模式”是合成孔径雷达工作的一种模式，其中雷达波束在某一特定区域进行长时间的聚焦，以获得更高的空间分辨率。
7．“光束发散角”是指光束在传播过程中发散的程度，通常用来描述激光束或其他类型光束的聚焦性能。
8．“无线电视距”是指在没有任何障碍物的情况下，无线电波在自由空间中传播的最大距离。
text.en: that uses synthetic-aperture techniques to obtain high-resolution radar images for applications such as terrain mapping and environmental monitoring. 3. A “target-designating laser” is military laser equipment that precisely points to and marks a target so that laser-guided weapons can engage it. 4. “Instantaneous field of view” means the angular field a detector covers at a given instant; it determines the detector's spatial resolution. 5. “Stripmap mode” is a synthetic-aperture radar operating mode in which the radar beam continuously scans the ground along the flight direction, forming a wide swath. 6. “Spotlight mode” is a synthetic-aperture radar operating mode in which the radar beam remains focused on a specific area for an extended period to obtain higher spatial resolution. 7. “Beam divergence” means the extent to which a beam spreads during propagation, commonly used to describe the focusing performance of laser or other light beams. 8. “Radio line of sight” means the maximum distance radio waves propagate through free space without obstructions.

title.zh: 非9A012.b 项所管制的涡轮喷气发动机和涡轮风扇发动机：
title.en: Turbojet and turbofan engines other than those controlled under 9A012.b:

summary.zh: 非9A012.b 项所管制的涡轮喷气发动机和涡轮风扇发动机：
summary.en: Turbojet and turbofan engines other than those controlled under 9A012.b:

text.zh:
9A101 非9A012.b 项所管制的涡轮喷气发动机和涡轮风扇发动机：
a．推力大于等于90 kN 的涡轮喷气发动机；
b．涡轮风扇发动机；
c．涡轮组合式发动机。
说明：9A101 项不管制集成到民用飞机、通用航空器等民用航空器上的涡轮喷气发动机和涡轮风扇发动机。“无人驾驶航空器”及相关物项的出口管制，本清单另有规定的，依照其规定。
text.en: 9A101 Turbojet and turbofan engines other than those controlled under 9A012.b: a. Turbojet engines with thrust of 90 kN or greater; b. Turbofan engines; c. Turbine-based combined-cycle engines. Note: 9A101 does not control turbojet or turbofan engines integrated into civil aircraft, including civil airplanes and general-aviation aircraft. Where this List otherwise provides for export controls on "unmanned aerial vehicles" and related items, those provisions apply.

text.en: 9A106 Liquid and slurry propellant control systems designed or modified to operate in vibration environments over 20–2000 Hz and at accelerations greater than 10 g₀ RMS, and specially designed components therefor: a. Pumps for liquid propellants with a rotational speed of 8000 rpm or greater and an outlet pressure of 7000 kPa or greater. Note: 9A106 does not control servo valves or pumps integrated into civil aircraft, including civil airplanes and general-aviation aircraft.

title.en: “Unmanned aerial vehicles” other than those controlled under 9A012:

summary.zh: 非9A012 项所管制的“无人驾驶航空器”：
summary.en: “Unmanned aerial vehicles” other than those controlled under 9A012:

text.zh:
9A501 非9A012 项所管制的“无人驾驶航空器”：
a．“射/航程”大于等于300 km 的“无人驾驶航空器”；
b．具有以下任一特性，具备自主飞行控制和导航能力的“无人驾驶航空器”：
1．包含容量为20 L 以上的气雾剂布撒系统/装置；
2．经设计或改进后能够配备容量20 L 以上的气雾剂布撒系统/装置；
c．具有以下任一特性，具备操作员从视距外控制飞行能力的“无人驾驶航空器”：
1．包含容量为20 L 以上的气雾剂布撒系统/装置；
2．经设计或改进后能够配备容量20 L 以上的气雾剂布撒系统/装置。
说明：
1．9A501 项不管制为娱乐或竞赛专门设计的模型飞机。
2．对于未列入本清单的所有“无人驾驶航空器”，出口经营者明知或者应当知道出口将用于大规模杀伤性武器扩散、恐怖主义活动或者军事目的的，不得出口。违反规定的，按照《中华人民共和国出口管制法》第三十四条处罚。
text.en: 9A501 “Unmanned aerial vehicles” other than those controlled under 9A012: a. “Unmanned aerial vehicles” with a “range” of 300 km or greater; b. “Unmanned aerial vehicles” capable of autonomous flight control and navigation, having either of the following characteristics: 1. Incorporating an aerosol-dissemination system/device with a capacity of 20 L or greater; 2. Designed or modified to accommodate an aerosol-dissemination system/device with a capacity of 20 L or greater; c. “Unmanned aerial vehicles” capable of operator-controlled flight beyond visual line of sight, having either of the following characteristics: 1. Incorporating an aerosol-dissemination system/device with a capacity of 20 L or greater; 2. Designed or modified to accommodate an aerosol-dissemination system/device with a capacity of 20 L or greater. Notes: 1. 9A501 does not control model aircraft specially designed for recreation or competition. 2. For all “unmanned aerial vehicles” not included in this list, exporters shall not export if they know or should know that the export will be used for proliferation of weapons of mass destruction, terrorist activities, or military purposes. Violations shall be penalized under Article 34 of the Export Control Law of the People's Republic of China.

title.en: “High-pressure water cannons” having all of the following characteristics:

summary.zh: 具有以下所有特性的“高压水炮”：
summary.en: “High-pressure water cannons” having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh:
0A901 具有以下所有特性的“高压水炮”：
a．“最大射程”大于等于100 m；
b．“额定流量”大于等于540 m³/h；
c．“额定压力”大于等于1.2 MPa。
技术说明：
1．“高压水炮”是一种以高压水泵对液体介质做功，形成可在空气中远距离喷射高速流体的设备。
2．“最大射程”是指水炮出口到洒落区域的最远距离。最大射程处伤害力较小，也不存在瞄准的可能。
3．“额定流量”是指在额定工况下的流量。
4．“额定压力”是指在满足设备正常工作需求下的最大压力。
text.en: 0A901 “High-pressure water cannons” having all of the following characteristics: a. A “maximum range” of 100 m or greater; b. A “rated flow rate” of 540 m³/h or greater; c. A “rated pressure” of 1.2 MPa or greater. Technical Notes: 1. A “high-pressure water cannon” is equipment that uses a high-pressure pump to transfer energy to a liquid medium, producing a high-speed fluid jet that can travel long distances through the air. 2. “Maximum range” means the greatest distance from the water-cannon outlet to the area where the water lands. At maximum range, its injuring force is relatively low and aiming is not possible. 3. “Rated flow rate” means the flow rate under rated operating conditions. 4. “Rated pressure” means the maximum pressure consistent with the equipment's normal operating requirements.
